climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Chardonnay sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.

blurb.text: A Côte Chalonnaise appellation in Burgundy, for white wine made only from Chardonnay, across four communes. It has 49 Premier Cru vineyards and no Grand Cru.
